limitations: Run clocks accelerated and encounter loot/specs controlled only in explicitly marked legitimate-play fixtures. Exploit regression uses no engine/time/loot edits.
Automated replay validates game inputs; it does not prove a human supplied them or prevent bots playing legal moves.
